milestone: PBUF METRIC-001 — Derivation of the Effective Relativistic Metric

metric_map.domain: A subset of {(q,C[q,q0],D): q in Q_adm, C in D_C, D accepted duration structure}

mandatory_properties.reference_normalization: G[q0,1] is locally eta in an unloaded V11 inertial frame
mandatory_properties.propagation_match: g_eff(k,k)=0 for universal V11 signal characteristics

regularity.minimum_global: continuous on the interior operational domain
regularity.weak_limit: Frechet or suitable Gateaux differentiable at q0
regularity.at_hard_bound: one-sided interior regularity only unless a regular extension is separately selected

dependence_classes.local_subclass: finite-jet natural operator Gcal(j^r q,j^r C;D), r finite but unselected
dependence_classes.derivative: admissible but derivative order not derived
dependence_classes.nonlocal: admissible only with a covariant causal kernel

linearization.equation: g_eff = eta + R0[delta q] + O(norm(delta q)^2)

admissible_endpoint_classes: operational domain terminates at the elastic boundary
loss of effective regularity defines an earlier/on-boundary limit of validity

covariance_split.bridge: G descends to physical state classes and intertwines native and effective transformations
